heroLead: Focal WCMS is four desks that publish as one official site: Focal Layout Editor, Locale Manager, Focal WCMS Content Manager, and Focal AI. Arrange, translate, schedule, and ask — the published route is what you already reviewed.
proofTitle: This official site is built on Focal WCMS.
proofBody: Navbar, locales, product pages, and enquiry paths are the same four products we offer you — layout on the canvas, copy in the locale list, pages in the Content Manager, and an agent that can read the page it sits on.
suiteLead: Change the page today. Publish it today. Layout, languages, and go-live stay in your hands.
suite0Blurb: Dynamic, elastic canvas. What you see is what ships.
suite1Blurb: Separate versioning and a page-scoped locale list the canvas actually binds.
suite2Blurb: No-code pages, scheduled go-live, media in one library.
suite3Blurb: An agent with the page’s data — and the skills to build the next one.
layoutTitle: Design the layout that will actually go live.
layoutBody: Heroes, tabs, screenshots, and enquiry bands are first-class sections. Move them, nest them, stretch them — the canvas is not a mock. It is the page.
layoutFeat0Body: Sections reflow as you add, nest, and rearrange. The page is a living structure, not a frozen artboard.
layoutFeat1Body: Layout stretches across viewports without a second canvas for every breakpoint.
layoutFeat2Title: What you see is what you get
layoutFeat2Body: Editors and designers share the same surface. No wireframe that silently diverges from production.
layoutFeat3Body: Preview matches the layout visitors will see once you publish — not a theme approximation.
layoutAlt: Official homepage artboard in the Focal Layout Editor
localeBody: English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese share a page — not three cloned sites. Each locale can move on its own clock, and the Layout Editor reads the keys that belong to that page.
localeFeat0Body: Each locale keeps its own draft and publish timeline. Shipping English does not force a half-translated Chinese pin live.
localeFeat1Body: Copy keys live on the page. The Focal Layout Editor binds those keys — not a global dump of every string on the site.
localeFeat2Body: On full page save or launch, Focal AI can fill sibling locales so a launch is not three copy-paste nights.
localeAlt: Locale Manager with a page-scoped custom locale list
cmTitle: Stand up a page without a ticket queue.
cmBody: The Content Manager is where pages exist: routes, drafts, media, and the calendar that decides when the public sees them. Layout stays on the canvas; records stay here.
cmFeat0Body: Create a public route from the Content Manager. You do not wait on a frontend deploy for a page to exist.
cmFeat1Body: Go live for a briefing. Take it down after the campaign. Engineering does not have to be in the room.
cmFeat2Body: Images and assets live in one library. Layout and locales reuse them instead of scattering files across folders.
cmAlt: Focal WCMS Content Manager listing locale-aware official pages
cmAlt2: Media and navigation records in the Focal WCMS Content Manager
aiTitle: An agent that already knows this page.
aiBody: Focal AI is not a chatbot parked beside the CMS. It reads the page’s own data, edits through the same desks your editors use, and can be tuned as deeply as the programme requires.
aiFeat0Title: Ask the page, not the internet
aiFeat0Body: An intelligent LLM agent answers questions about the page with direct access to that page’s records — locales, layout, media — not a generic crawl.
aiFeat1Body: Dedicated skills and MCP let the agent create an entire page from scratch: fitting layout, appropriate locales, and assets — through Content Manager and Focal Layout Editor.
aiFeat2Body: Model, tools, review gates, and how far the agent may write are yours to customise — not a one-size assistant.
aiMockQ: What copy keys does the homepage locale list bind in the Layout Editor?
aiMockA: Page-scoped keys such as home.headline and home.heroCta. I can draft a sibling locale or open the canvas on those bindings.
ctaTitle: Ready for a site your team can still change next quarter?
ctaSubtitle: We will walk the Layout Editor, Locale Manager, Content Manager, and Focal AI against your programme — then show how enquiry lands with FDS.
